authorization: 先跑15组，验证通过后开始正式训练，预算按实际耗时来估。
scope: Supervised maze comparison inside PyDPF; not MLE, IF2, IFAD or PyPOMP speed comparison
normalization: Original scalar image normalization, using training images only; no validation or test images in estimated mean/std

native_settings.loss: Mean all-time normalized position squared error + sine/cosine direction error + image reconstruction MSE

selection: Lowest validation final-time position MSE; earliest epoch on ties. Common original ordinary PF with systematic resampling. Test never used for selection.

evaluation.primary: sqrt(mean squared final-time position distance across 700 trajectories and 3 independent PF streams)); original coordinate units

pairing: Same initialization, minibatch order, private/default RNG and validation/test seeds across methods for each of five cases. Different cases have different training streams; one training repetition each.
execution: External four-FCNN CUDA Graph adapter only; native filter/model/loss unchanged. Separate cached graph per B=64 and B=4; inference delegates to original forward.

resources.budget_record: budget.json, created only after actual stopped bridge saved audit passes
resources.point_forecast: Measured median full B64 step and measuredB4 step, shape-specific warm ordinaryPF evaluations for600B64+100B16validation and30B64+3B60test calls; separately list cold/setup/launch/checkpoint allowances.
resources.request_limit: Compute each arm requested seconds from measured upper warm costs plus35percent recurring-work headroom and explicitly documented startup/serialization allowance, round up towholeminute. Original2700seconds remains a safety ceiling, not a runtime forecast.

failures: Retain exceptions, nonfinite gradients/proposals and last valid checkpoint. No retries or selecting successful runs. If a completed validation checkpoint exists, evaluate it once and flag incomplete fit; otherwise test unavailable.
reporting: All5paired initializations per method retained. Individual RMSE points and paired differences; no smooth population density or assumed ordering. Equalepochs, not equalruntime. Five initializations do not estimate within-initialization repeat variation separately.
preflight: New CPU saved optimizer-chain checks and one GPU bridge/cost allocation, all three arms B64/B4 and evaluation/restore; formal jobs only after saved audit and cost pass. No extension of old completed budgets.
numerical_source: Unmodified parent frozen70-file source; original train.py --case uses these five even indices, giving seeds0/10/20/30/40 and repetition0.
prior_protocol_retained: Parent protocol.json remains immutable historical36-fit design. This overlay defines the actual15-task selection and measured budget.
